text: iPhone port step 1: iOS implementations of the platform interfaces

Implemented in :shared's iosMain (not :core's), since the stores and the Koin modules live there. Findings: the Keychain is unavailable (errSecNotAvailable, -25291) to the bare test binary KGP spawns on the simulator, so KeychainSecretStoreTest's token tests skip there with a printed reason; the store is exercised by the app's login (T-353), and could run under XCTest from the Xcode project. InAppSyncTrigger replaces WorkManager only while the app is open; T-354 adds BGTaskScheduler. Notifiers are silent until T-354. Koin 4.1 has no GlobalContext: KoinPlatform.getKoin().
